title: 배터리 18%
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a solo cello playing a melodic, legato line in the intro, followed by a fingerstyle acoustic guitar that maintains a steady eighth-note pattern. A clean electric guitar provides occasional ambient swells and melodic fills. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate and breathy in the lower register, transitioning to a more resonant chest voice as the melody ascends. The production is sparse, emphasizing the natural decay of the strings and the clarity of the vocal track.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[legato cello melody]
[acoustic guitar enters, fingerstyle eighth notes]

[Verse 1]
[breathy baritone male vocals]
그땐 들어서
10년이 지났는데
아직도 심장이 조여 들어
이상하지 분명히 끝났는데
왜 아직도 이래 그 사람 잘 살고 있다더라
그게 왜 화가 나

[Pre-Chorus]
분석해 봤어
내가 뭘 원하는 건지 그 사람이 잘못되길 바라는 건 아니야
근데 이 화가 어디로 가야 해 [clean electric guitar swell]
